title: Red and Blue Graph
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq M \leq 2 \times 10^5; 0 \leq K \leq N; 1 \leq U_i \lt V_i \leq N \, (1 \leq i \leq M); (U_i, V_i) \neq (U_j, V_j) \, (i \neq j); All values in input are integers.
